parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no further queries are available.

- If **NextToken** has a value, use it as the starting token for the next query.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
